title: etbb-july-2024-may-2025-update.pdf — section 62
text:
142. An employee may represent the company at a fast-track or multi-track interim or final
hearing, provided the employee has been authorised by the company to appear and the
court gives permission (CPR 39.6).

143. This does not apply to small claims. Any officer or employee may represent the company on
a small claim (CPR Part 27 PD 3.2(4)).
Official Receivers

144. Rule 7.52 of the Insolvency Rules 1986 gives Official Receivers a right of audience in both
the High Court and a county court.
Official Solicitor

145. The Official Solicitor represents parties to proceedings who lack capacity to conduct litigation
(“protected parties”) or who are deceased or unascertained when no other suitable person or
agency is able and willing to do so in civil courts. The purpose is to prevent a possible denial
of justice and safeguard the welfare, property or status of the party.
